chunks: From him, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Faḍālah, from Jamīl ibn Darrāj, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I saw Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام coming from the bathhouse, and between him and his house there was filth. So he said: “Were it not for what is between me and my house, I would not have washed my foot, nor would I have removed the bathhouse water.”

key_terms.قَذَرٌ: filth or dirt on the path

ai.seo_question: Why did Imam Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام wash his foot after coming from the bathhouse?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates that Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام, upon returning from the bathhouse, washed his foot because there was filth on the path to his house. The report indicates practical concern for taharah (ritual purity) and cleanliness in relation to impure surroundings, while suggesting that the bathhouse water itself was not the reason for washing in this instance.
